description: Forecast for Crosby, TX from the U.S. National Weather Service. Returns the 7-day day/night forecast, or upcoming hourly periods if `hours` is given (up to 48 — through about two days out).

hours.description: Return this many upcoming hourly periods instead of the daily forecast.

name: get_forecast

items.description: An NWS forecast period, passed through (startTime, temperature, shortForecast, windSpeed, probabilityOfPrecipitation, ...) plus computed feelsLike °F where applicable. Full schema: https://crosbynews.com/openapi.json

hourly.description: Upcoming hourly periods (only when `hours` was given).
